Package neqsim.process.mechanicaldesign.subsea

Class UmbilicalHydraulicsCalculator

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.mechanicaldesign.subsea.UmbilicalHydraulicsCalculator
public final class UmbilicalHydraulicsCalculator extends Object
Hydraulics of a liquid-filled umbilical tube or hose: steady friction pressure drop, hydrostatic head, flow capacity for a given pressure budget, and the dynamic response of a long control line.

Steady flow uses the Darcy-Weisbach equation with the laminar friction factor 64/Re, the Haaland explicit form of Colebrook for turbulent flow and a linear blend over 2300 < Re < 4000. Line response is modelled as a distributed resistance-compliance line: the laminar resistance R = 128 mu L / (pi D^4) and the compliance of the liquid (bulk modulus) in series with the elastic expansion of the tube wall. A pressure step at one end of the closed line is solved with the exact diffusion series, and the acoustic transit time L/c is reported as a lower bound.

1.0
